text:
Hello, I'm writing to ask where I am on the counselling waitlist. I referred myself on 14 September and was told the wait would be about eight weeks, so I expected a call by now. My name is Thandiwe Mokoena, and you can reach me at thandiwe.mokoena@example.org or on 07700 900314. My waitlist reference is CW-48213. Last month my GP, Dr Henrik Aalto, wrote that my anxiety is moderate to severe and that I should not wait longer than twelve weeks. I can only do appointments after 5pm because of my shifts. Please tell me my current position, whether the eight-week estimate still stands, and whether an evening slot is possible.

Thanks, Thandiwe
task: Tidy this into a polite, firm email to the counselling service that asks for my waitlist position and an evening slot.

text: Notes for my disability benefit review call. The assessor, Ruth Kimathi, rang on Tuesday and said my claim number is DB-7720-5531 and that my award of 128.40 pounds a week will stay unchanged unless the review finds I can walk more than 50 metres unaided. She posted the form to 14 Tamarind Row, Leeds LS6 2QT but I have not received it. My National Insurance number is QQ 123456 C if you need it for the call. My carer is my brother, Pham Quoc Bao, and he thinks the form should have been emailed to him at bao.pham@example.net as I authorised. I need a script to chase this politely, mention that I cannot walk 50 metres without a rest, and ask for a copy by email.
task: Write a short script for my phone call chasing the missing review form and asking for it to be emailed. Keep the details of what the assessor said.

text: Hi, I need help writing to the benefits office. I look after my mum, Bridget Quigley, for about 38 hours a week, and I claim Carer's Allowance under reference CA-3391-807. Their letter dated 2 July says I was overpaid 412 pounds because my earnings went over the limit in the weeks of 3 June and 10 June. I did one-off cover shifts then, and my payslips show 112 pounds and 98 pounds, not the 190 pounds each they used. I am not disputing that I worked, only the amounts. I'm Mairead Quigley, email mairead.q@example.com, phone 07700 900455. The adviser, Tomasz Wrona, said last week that I can ask for a mandatory reconsideration within one month.
task: Draft the mandatory reconsideration request from these facts, stating the corrected earnings and that I am disputing the amounts, not the work.

text: Hello, I have booked two tickets for the 21 March recital, booking reference RT-904127. I use a power wheelchair that is 68 cm wide, so I need the step-free entrance, not the main door with three steps. Your access officer, Kwabena Asante, told my friend Ilona Farkas on the phone that the lift is out of service until 2 April, but I read online it was repaired last week. Which is correct? If it is still out, I would need a ground-floor seat with a companion seat beside it, at no extra cost. My email is ayse.demirci@example.org and you can also text me on 07700 900226. Regards, Ayşe Demirci
task: Turn this into a clear accessibility request email asking them to confirm the lift status and the seating, keeping the dimensions and conditions.

text: Hi, I'm writing to the clinic about my CBT. I have been seeing Marit Solheim every Wednesday at 4pm, and I've had 7 of my 12 sessions. From 6 November I can't do Wednesdays after 2pm because of my new work schedule, so I'd like to stay with Marit if she has Thursday mornings, and only move to someone else if she doesn't. Please don't cancel my remaining five sessions. The sessions have helped a lot, and I'd rather not lose momentum before the new year. My patient number is MH-20-66431, and my dad, Baek Jun-ho, is my emergency contact on 07700 900518. Thank you, Eun-ji Baek

text:

text: I'm appealing the decision to stop my Employment and Support Allowance. My adviser at the advice centre, Declan Foy, thinks we should ask for a phone hearing, not an in-person one. Refund details if needed: IBAN IE00DEMO99887766554433, account holder Priyanka Venkataraman, contact priyanka.v@example.org.

text: Dear HR, I am disputing the overtime on my October payslip. My team lead, Pekka Virtanen, told me on 22 October that Saturday shifts would be paid at double time, not time and a half, but the payslip shows time and a half for 12 hours. I am in salary band C and my base rate is 18.75 pounds an hour. I think I am owed 112.50 pounds, unless the policy says double time only applies after 40 hours that week. Your colleague Ifeoma Chukwu said she would check by Friday but I have not heard back. My staff number is 441-209, my phone is 07700 900781, and I'm happy to send the rota. Regards, Nokuthula Dlamini

text: I need to sort out my counselling fees. My counsellor, Ingrid Halvorsen, told me in the first session that the sliding-scale fee would be 25 pounds, not 40 as on the website, because my income is under 1,400 pounds a month. My mother, Lucia Ferreira, offered to pay the difference only if the charity refuses a refund. I have not decided whether to accept that.

The tribunal clerk, Naledi Sithole, said in her email that they can provide a hearing loop and a break every 30 minutes, but not a home visit. text: Where things stand with my depression referral. I want to write this down before my next call with the practice, so that I remember what each person told me. My GP, Dr Ravi Subramaniam, said he would refer me for therapy, not medication, and that the wait is probably 10 to 14 weeks. The practice manager, Odile Marchetti, says the referral was sent on 4 November, but the clinic's letter says they got nothing. If it was not sent, my GP promised he'd resend it by Friday. My partner, Jonah Pelletier, thinks I should pay for 6 private sessions at 55 pounds each (330 pounds in total) only if the NHS wait goes beyond 12 weeks. I have not decided.
task: Summarise where the referral stands, who said what, and the private-therapy option with its condition.

text: Hi, I help run a small peer-support charity website and we have been asked to make it more accessible. Could you explain how WCAG 2.2 level AA differs from level AAA, and which fixes matter most for people using screen readers? Our site runs WordPress 6.5 on PHP 8.2. The contrast checker reports a ratio of 4.3:1 for the grey body text on white, and the old PDF forms return HTTP 404 since we moved them. I have also read that the Equality Act 2010 expects reasonable adjustments, and that the NHS Talking Therapies service publishes its own accessibility statement. What should we fix first, and which of those points is a legal requirement rather than good practice?
task: Give me a prioritised list of accessibility fixes for the site and explain what the law requires versus what is optional.

text: Our payroll team keeps getting a failure when the weekly export runs. The log says: POST /v1/timesheets returned HTTP 422, error code E_DATE_FORMAT, client version 3.2.1, port 8443. I think the export uses DD/MM/YYYY dates but the API expects ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Can you explain how to convert the dates in a CSV with Python's datetime module and pandas 2.1? We also need to check that overtime is stored as decimal hours, for example 7.5 rather than 7:30. Finally, I read that the Working Time Regulations 1998 set an average 48-hour week limit over a 17-week reference period. Is that right, and does it apply to payroll calculations or only to scheduling? Please keep the answer practical for a small HR team.
task: Explain how to fix the date format failure and answer the question about the 48-hour week rule.

text:
Why am I getting a 401 here? I ran this from my laptop and it worked yesterday.

curl -s https://hr-api.internal.test/v2/salary-bands -H "Authorization: Bearer hrb.demo.7Qm2xVd9" -H "Accept: application/json"

Response now: {"status":401,"error":"token_expired","message":"Token lifetime exceeded, request a new one"}

Yesterday's response for band D was {"band":"D","min":61000,"max":74500,"currency":"GBP"}. My colleague Hamza Qureshi says tokens last 24 hours, but the docs page says 12. I'm not sure which is right. I have checked the clock on my laptop and it is correct. I need to know how to refresh the token without asking IT each time, and whether adding a retry on 401 is sensible. The same call runs in our nightly script, which fails around 02:00.
task: Explain the likely cause of the 401 and how to refresh the token, and say whether a retry on 401 is sensible.
